seoDescription: View the Austin ISD 2025–26 calendar with first and last days, major breaks, student holidays, PLED day, PDF and ICS downloads.
heroSummary: Austin ISD's traditional calendar includes a PLED Day on October 10 and student holidays connected to campus and district staff development. Diwali coincides with Parent Conference Day, and Dolores Huerta Day is observed March 31.
calendarNotes: Austin ISD's 2025–26 traditional calendar lists August 19 as the first day, May 28 as the last day, a PLED day on October 10, and several student holidays tied to staff development or parent conference days. Students do not attend on January 5; classes resume Tuesday, January 6, after winter break and the campus staff development day.
heroFactChips: Students return January 6 after winter break
instructionalDaysDescription: The Austin ISD 2025–26 traditional calendar lists 180 instructional days.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the first day of school for Austin ISD in 2025–26?
calendarFaqs.a: The first day of school on Austin ISD's 2025–26 traditional calendar was Tuesday, August 19, 2025.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for Austin ISD in 2025–26?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day of school on Austin ISD's 2025–26 traditional calendar is Thursday, May 28, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Austin ISD winter break in 2025–26?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter break runs Monday, December 22, 2025, through Friday, January 2, 2026. January 5 is a campus staff development day, and students return Tuesday, January 6.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Austin ISD spring break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Austin ISD spring break runs Monday, March 16 through Friday, March 20, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: What is a PLED day in Austin ISD?
calendarFaqs.a: PLED stands for Professional Learning Exchange Day. Austin ISD explains that eligible employees can complete professional learning outside regular work time in exchange for designated PLED days.

calendarFaqs.q: Will the downloaded calendar update automatically?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The calendar file is a one-time import and will not update automatically if Austin ISD revises its calendar. Check the official Austin ISD calendar page for later changes.
